title: Figure 1.5: Schematic of the UIUC RF Gun Injector for IEC Experiments
description: Cross-section line schematic of Miley's radio-frequency ion injector ('gun') for an inertial electrostatic confinement (IEC) chamber. Labeled components include a magnetic focusing lens, stainless steel flange, ceramic insulator, coaxial copper resonator ('hollow cylindrical'), helical antenna, glass tube, RF generator, magnetic differential coils, and D2 gas feed. An ion beam exits toward a negative-potential electrode at the positive vacuum-chamber wall, with upper and lower plasma streams marked 'floating'.
